date:conversion-of-ethiopian-eunuch@66b3.note: Text gives no year. Placed after the persecution and the Samaria mission (8:1, 8:26). Year 32 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:philip-preaches-in-samaria@84a195.note: Text gives no year. Follows the scattering after Stephen's death (8:4-5). Year 31 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:saul-persecutes-the-church@84a195.note: Text gives no year. Follows directly after Stephen's stoning (7:58-8:1). Year 31 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:stephen-addresses-the-council@22ede.note: Text gives no year. Stephen answers the high priest's question (7:1-2). Year 30 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:stephen-is-stoned@84a195.note: Text gives no year. Stoning follows Stephen's speech (7:54-58). Year 31 depends on dating outside Scripture.

occurred-at:conversion-of-ethiopian-eunu.note: Text puts it on the desert road toward Gaza, at a water on the way (8:26, 8:36-38), not at Gaza.

occurred-at:stephen-addresses-the-counci.note: The place is not named. The high priest's council and stoning 'out of the city' (7:1, 7:58) fit Jerusalem, where the church is at 8:1.

occurred-at:stephen-is-stoned>jerusalem_.note: The place is not named. Stoned 'out of the city' (7:58), and the church at Jerusalem scatters after it (8:1-2). Reading.

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>convers.note: The Spirit speaks to Philip, sending him to the chariot (8:29), and catches Philip away after the baptism (8:39).

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>philip-.note: The Holy Ghost is received by the Samaritans through the apostles' prayer and hands (8:15-17). The Spirit is given, not described as acting. Reading.

participated-in:john_1677>philip-preache.note: John is sent with Peter to Samaria and prays for the converts (8:14-15). The text does not place him in Philip's preaching itself. Reading.

participated-in:paul_2479>saul-persecute.note: Saul makes havoc of the church, entering houses and committing men and women to prison (8:1, 8:3). Saul is called Paul in 13:9.

participated-in:paul_2479>stephen-is-sto.note: Witnesses lay their clothes at Saul's feet at the stoning (7:58), and Saul consented to Stephen's death (8:1). The text does not say he cast stones. Reading.

participated-in:peter_2745>philip-preach.note: Peter is sent to Samaria, prays for the converts, and rebukes Simon (8:14-15, 8:20). Not part of Philip's preaching itself. Reading.

participated-in:philip_2347>conversion-o.note: Philip is sent to the road to Gaza (8:26), preaches Jesus to the eunuch (8:35), and baptizes him (8:38).

participated-in:simon_2752>philip-preach.note: Simon believes Philip's preaching and is baptized, continuing with Philip (8:13). His sorcery is earlier (8:9).

participated-in:stephen_2802>saul-persec.note: Stephen was already dead (7:59-60) when the persecution began (8:1). Devout men buried him (8:2).

participated-in:stephen_2802>stephen-add.note: Stephen gives the speech: 'Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken' (7:2).

visited:philip_2344>jerusalem_636@f06516.note: Acts 8:26 concerns Philip the evangelist, not the apostle. Philip is an apostle (1:13), and the apostles stayed at Jerusalem (8:1, 8:14). Reading.

visited:simon_2752>samaria_1022@b7665f.note: Simon used sorcery 'in the same city' as the people of Samaria (8:9).
